# Extensions {#sec-extensions}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
# _common.R ----
source("_common.R")
# use font
showtext::showtext_auto()
# set theme
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_ggp2g(
    base_size = 15))
```

Most graphs in this book only need `ggplot2` and `dplyr`, but some graph types live in extension packages. The tables below list the extensions (and the helper packages) each chapter uses. I've used [`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/) for every install command because it handles packages on CRAN (`pak::pak("ggridges")`) and GitHub (`pak::pak("owner/repo")`) the same way.

## Graph extensions

::: {style="font-size: 0.90rem;"}
| Graph | Package | Install |
|----|----|----|
| [Waffle charts](waffle_charts.qmd) | [`ggwaffle`](https://liamgilbey.github.io/ggwaffle/) | `pak::pak("liamgilbey/ggwaffle")` |
| [Mosaic plots](mosaic_plots.qmd) | [`ggmosaic`](https://haleyjeppson.github.io/ggmosaic/) | `pak::pak("haleyjeppson/ggmosaic")` |
| [Pie charts](pie_charts.qmd) | [`ggpubr`](https://rpkgs.datanovia.com/ggpubr/) | `pak::pak("ggpubr")` |
| [Treemaps](treemaps.qmd) | [`treemapify`](https://wilkox.org/treemapify/) | `pak::pak("treemapify")` |
| [Beeswarm plots](beeswarm_plots.qmd) | [`ggbeeswarm`](https://github.com/eclarke/ggbeeswarm) | `pak::pak("ggbeeswarm")` |
| [Ridgeline plots](ridgeline_plots.qmd) | [`ggridges`](https://wilkelab.org/ggridges/) | `pak::pak("ggridges")` |
| [Raincloud plots](raincloud_plots.qmd) | [`raincloudplots`](https://github.com/jorvlan/raincloudplots) and [`ggdist`](https://mjskay.github.io/ggdist/) | `pak::pak(c("jorvlan/raincloudplots", "ggdist"))` |
| [Bump charts](bump_charts.qmd) | [`ggbump`](https://github.com/davidsjoberg/ggbump) | `pak::pak("davidsjoberg/ggbump")` |
| [Stream plots](stream_plots.qmd) | [`ggstream`](https://github.com/davidsjoberg/ggstream) | `pak::pak("davidsjoberg/ggstream")` |
| [Alluvial charts](alluvial_charts.qmd) | [`ggalluvial`](https://corybrunson.github.io/ggalluvial/) | `pak::pak("ggalluvial")` |
| [Parallel sets](parallel_sets.qmd) | [`ggforce`](https://ggforce.data-imaginist.com/) | `pak::pak("ggforce")` |
| [Hexagon bins](hex_bins.qmd) | [`hexbin`](https://github.com/edzer/hexbin) (used by `geom_hex()`) | `pak::pak("hexbin")` |
:::

## Helper packages

These packages don't add new graph types, but a few chapters rely on them to simulate data, combine graphs, or choose colors.

::: {style="font-size: 0.90rem;"}
| Package | What it's used for | Chapters | Install |
|----|----|----|----|
| [`faux`](https://debruine.github.io/faux/) | Simulating correlated variables (`rnorm_multi()`) and designs (`sim_design()`) | [Cleveland dot plots](cleveland_dot_plots.qmd), [raincloud plots](raincloud_plots.qmd), [grouped scatter plots](grouped_scatter_plots.qmd), [density contours](density_contours.qmd) | `pak::pak("faux")` |
| [`patchwork`](https://patchwork.data-imaginist.com/) | Combining graphs into one figure | [Mosaic plots](mosaic_plots.qmd), [overlapping and stacked density plots](overlapping_stacked_density_plots.qmd), [grouped line graphs](grp_line_graphs.qmd) | `pak::pak("patchwork")` |
| [`colorspace`](https://colorspace.r-forge.r-project.org/) | Sequential color palettes | [2D histograms](bins_2d.qmd), [hexagon bins](hex_bins.qmd) | `pak::pak("colorspace")` |
| [`fmggp2`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/fmggp2/) | The 90s themes and book helpers (see @sec-theme) | Every chapter | `pak::pak("mjfrigaard/fmggp2")` |
:::

The code below installs everything at once.

::: {style="font-size: 0.85em;"}
```{r}
#| label: install_all
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: show
pak::pak(c(
  "liamgilbey/ggwaffle", "haleyjeppson/ggmosaic", "ggpubr", "treemapify",
  "ggbeeswarm", "ggridges", "jorvlan/raincloudplots", "ggdist",
  "davidsjoberg/ggbump", "davidsjoberg/ggstream", "ggalluvial", "ggforce", "hexbin",
  "faux", "patchwork", "colorspace", "mjfrigaard/fmggp2"))
```
:::
